name: Fremont Unified Career and Technical Education
what_you_do: You can take career and technical education classes at Fremont Unified middle and high schools in 15 industry sectors and 58 career pathways. Some are inside California Partnership Academies or regional occupational programs.
who_can_apply: Students at Fremont Unified middle and high schools. The page says limited English is not a barrier to joining career and technical education programs.
deadline_text: No dates stated. Choose courses at your school.
how_to_apply: The page gives no sign-up steps. Ask your school counselor or principal, or contact Leslie Heller, Director of Secondary Education, (510) 659-2513.
notes: The page is general. It lists 15 industry sectors and 58 career pathways. It does not list internship partners or work-based learning. Ask your counselor which pathways your school offers.
